name: meeting-copilot
description: Transparent meeting overlay that streams answers in real time.
author: Pradeep Singh <pradeep.singh@rodicconsultants.com>

extendInfo.NSAudioCaptureUsageDescription: Meeting Copilot listens to meeting audio to answer questions in real time.
extendInfo.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Meeting Copilot listens to your microphone so answers have your side of the conversation.
extendInfo.NSScreenCaptureUsageDescription: Meeting Copilot needs system audio capture and runs a self-test that checks the overlay stays hidden from screen sharing.
